Form input elements produce readable output without form mechanics

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"preprocessing\":{\"remove_forms\":false}}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<form><label for=\"name\">Name:</label><input type=\"text\" id=\"name\" placeholder=\"Enter name\"></form>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
